keys_read_detail.note: all 297 key/value pairs read side by side against English and the en context sidecar; all 297 also parsed with the repo's ICU parser and compared value-by-value (arguments, arms, tags)

observations: events.joined «{targets} گفتگو میں شامل» is copula-free beside events.left's «چھوڑ دی»; UR-A5/UR-B2 recorded the fragment as the number-neutral trade-off, and it is kept.

events.others renders «مزید #» while ui.browser.ur.upload_more renders «{count} مزید» and core ur renders «# مزید». Both orders are idiomatic Urdu and the tail survives every postpositional line («… اور مزید 2 کو ہٹا دیا»), because «مزید» is indeclinable — the case failure that forced hi's revert does not exist here. Recorded as a cross-namespace word-order difference, not a defect.
list.error_pane says «دائیں جانب» (right side) where the English says «on the left»: correct for an RTL window whose list is mirrored, not a mistranslation.
checks: Key set: 297 keys on both sides, no missing or extra key (scripts/i18n/ledger-assemble.mjs refuses an incomplete locale, so this is also machine-checked at assembly).

ICU structure: all 297 values parsed with @formatjs/icu-messageformat-parser 3.5.21 (the parser intl-messageformat 12.1.3, the engine src/i18n/messages.ts calls, is built on) and their skeletons compared with English: argument names, plural/selectordinal arms, offsets, number/date skeletons and tag names. Every argument and arm matches English except the es/fr `many` additions (required by CLDR) and hi attachments.position/open, which legitimately put {count} before {index} for «कुल {count} में से …».
Placeholders: none dropped, renamed or added in any of the 297 keys; {actor}/{targets}/{count} survive literally.
CLDR arms: every plural carries the categories its locale needs (es/fr one+many+other, hi/ur one+other) except the single finding above.
NFC: every value is NFC-normalised (checked with Python unicodedata over all 297).
Bidi: no U+200E/200F/202A-202E/2066-2069/U+061C in any value of any of the four locales; the ur file carries no manual bidi controls, as ur.md requires (the render layer isolates).
Markup: no HTML-ish or <0>-style tags in any value, so no markup token could have been dropped.

Typography: fr uses U+202F before « : ; ? » and inside « » throughout (measured, 0 exceptions in this namespace) and U+2019 apostrophes; es uses ¿ … ? and no space before ':' (13/13 colons); hi uses the danda «।» (108 values) and «?» only for the question; ur uses «۔ ، ؟ » and «“ ”» and no ASCII '?'.
Register: es is tú throughout (0 usted forms), fr is vous throughout (0 tu/ton/tes), hi is आप, ur is آپ — one address form per locale, no screen-level mismatch.

Render: the 12-key event/consent block rendered with the repo's intl-messageformat at 1 and 3 targets, and events.others at counts 1/2/3/5/11/21 plus the real truncated composition (5 names, first 3 shown, the plural tail appended as the list's last element through Intl.ListFormat conjunction) into every sibling sentence.
Width: median growth 1.05x-1.23x of English; the widest line pair is events.joined/left in es/fr (2.3x-2.6x), recorded rather than churned because the nominal form is what makes it number-neutral.
